_about: Monster species. Wild monsters and companions share these stats: stats = base + growth × (level − 1). captureRate 0 means it can't be captured. `art` is an id from art/assets.json. Variants like Frost Puff reuse a base monster's art with a free palette swap (see art/assets.json). Rare colour variants (`rare`, `variantOf`) are about 30% tougher, give more EXP and gold, and are harder to catch. `motion` is how it fidgets standing still (breathe, squish, hop, sway, bounce). Bosses (`boss`) can't be captured and wait on the map to be challenged; they're back for a rematch each time you return to their map, and every win rolls each of their `drops` (item, chance 0-1). `lore` is the Monster Book entry you unlock by meeting it in battle.

monsters.name: Fluffy Bunny
monsters.lore: Meadow bunnies nibble clover all day and thump their feet when strangers come close. Most adventurers' very first fight, and first friend.

monsters.name: Jelly Puff
monsters.lore: A wobbly drop of spring water that learned to bounce. Jelly Puffs gather near ponds and burst into giggles of bubbles when hit.

monsters.name: Pineapple Sprout
monsters.lore: A pineapple top that grew legs and a temper. It hides among the shore bushes and fires needles at anyone after its fruit.

monsters.name: Bouncy Bun
monsters.lore: Soft, round and stubborn as a stone, Bouncy Buns roll down the forest paths of Twilight Woods and flatten whatever's in the way.

monsters.name: Sakura Bunny
monsters.lore: Said to be born where cherry petals fall on a sleeping bunny. Its fur smells of spring and its nibble is strangely bright.

monsters.name: Frost Puff
monsters.lore: A Jelly Puff that slept through a cold night and woke up chilled to the core. Touching it leaves frost on your gloves.

monsters.name: Ember Puff
monsters.lore: A Jelly Puff warmed by swamp gas until it glowed. Keep it away from your hair.

monsters.name: Shade Puff
monsters.lore: A Jelly Puff that soaked up the gloom of the deep woods. It only comes out where the sunlight can't reach.

monsters.name: Dragonfruit Sprout
monsters.lore: A rare cousin of the Pineapple Sprout with a hot pink peel. Its needles sting like sparks.

monsters.name: Cotton Bun
monsters.lore: A Bouncy Bun as light as a cloud. Children in Meadowbrook wish on them for sweet dreams.

monsters.name: Night Bun
monsters.lore: A Bouncy Bun dark as midnight. It bounces silently, and you only notice it when it lands on you.

monsters.name: Golden Hamster
monsters.lore: Stuffs its cheeks with anything shiny, coins included. Beat one and you might get some of your gold back.

monsters.name: Azure Golden Hamster
monsters.lore: A sky-blue Golden Hamster. Collectors pay well just to see one.

monsters.name: Yellow Butterfly
monsters.lore: Meadow butterflies whose wings flash like little mirrors in the sun. The flash is pretty, and blinding.

monsters.name: Crimson Yellow Butterfly
monsters.lore: A Yellow Butterfly with wings like red silk. Spotting one is said to bring a lucky day.

monsters.name: Hedgehog
monsters.lore: A grumpy little digger that flings mud at anyone who steps on its tunnels. Its spines are softer than they look.

monsters.name: Starry Hedgehog
monsters.lore: A Hedgehog with spines that twinkle like a night sky. Nobody knows where it gets the stars.

monsters.name: Wood Crab
monsters.lore: A crab whose shell is bark, scuttling between driftwood on Pineapple Shore. It lashes out with vines it keeps tucked in its claws.

monsters.name: Rosy Wood Crab
monsters.lore: A Wood Crab with rose-coloured bark. It blushes deeper when angry.

monsters.name: Mud Eagle
monsters.lore: Nests in the muddy cliffs along the shore and dives on travellers with a gust of wet wind.

monsters.name: Frosted Mud Eagle
monsters.lore: A Mud Eagle with frost-white feathers, said to nest only on the coldest cliffs.

monsters.name: Wood Monkey
monsters.lore: Cheeky monkeys of the Smiling Forest. They steal apples, hats and anything that isn't tied down.

monsters.name: Shadow Wood Monkey
monsters.lore: A Wood Monkey with dark fur that hides in the canopy. You'll hear its laugh before you see it.

monsters.name: Tree Snake
monsters.lore: Hangs from branches pretending to be a vine until something walks underneath.

monsters.name: Sunny Tree Snake
monsters.lore: A Tree Snake with golden scales that likes to bask in the sun spots of the forest.

monsters.name: Flame Sheep
monsters.lore: Its wool is always smouldering. Shearing one is a job for the brave, or the fireproof.

monsters.name: Mint Flame Sheep
monsters.lore: A Flame Sheep with cool mint-green wool. Its fire smells oddly fresh.

monsters.name: Wood Hog
monsters.lore: A tusked boar that roots through the forest floor. Its roar can be heard across the Smiling Forest.

monsters.name: Violet Wood Hog
monsters.lore: A Wood Hog with purple bristles. Rarer, and even grumpier.

monsters.name: Werewolf
monsters.lore: Prowls Twilight Woods when the moon is up. Its bite carries a shadow that saps your strength.

monsters.name: Amber Werewolf
monsters.lore: A Werewolf with amber fur that glows faintly in moonlight.

monsters.name: Dark Beetle
monsters.lore: A shiny black beetle that thrives in caves and dark places. Its jaws are sharper than its manners.

monsters.name: Azure Dark Beetle
monsters.lore: A Dark Beetle with a blue sheen, found in the deepest caves.

monsters.name: Treefrog
monsters.lore: The croakers of Frog Swamp. They sing all night long and keep the whole region awake.

monsters.name: Crimson Treefrog
monsters.lore: A bright red Treefrog. The colour is a warning: it's tougher than it looks.

monsters.name: Blue Treefrog
monsters.lore: A Treefrog that took to the water. It spits bubbles instead of using vines.

monsters.name: Golden Treefrog
monsters.lore: A Treefrog with metallic gold skin. Swamp folk say it's the frogs' king in disguise.

monsters.name: Water Slug
monsters.lore: A slow, friendly slug that leaves a trail of fresh water. Calm until you poke it.

monsters.name: Starry Water Slug
monsters.lore: A Water Slug speckled with glowing dots, like a little piece of the night sky.

monsters.name: Wisp
monsters.lore: Floating lights that drift through Shiverdell. Some say they're lost souls; others say they're just shy.

monsters.name: Rosy Wisp
monsters.lore: A Wisp with a soft pink glow. Its flash is gentle but dazzling.

monsters.name: Earth Lion
monsters.lore: King of the open plains, with a mane caked in dust. Its roar shakes the ground.

monsters.name: Frosted Earth Lion
monsters.lore: An Earth Lion with a frost-white mane. Its roar leaves a chill in the air.

monsters.name: Blaze Bull
monsters.lore: Charges at anything red, and everything else too. Its horns are hot to the touch.

monsters.name: Shadow Blaze Bull
monsters.lore: A Blaze Bull with a coat as dark as soot. It charges without warning.

monsters.name: Fire Rat
monsters.lore: Lives in the warm tunnels of Rat Cavern and sets fire to anything it chews.

monsters.name: Sunny Fire Rat
monsters.lore: A Fire Rat with bright yellow fur that glows like a lantern in the dark tunnels.

monsters.name: Black Widow
monsters.lore: A desert spider that spins sticky webs across the dunes. Its bite is shadowy and cold.

monsters.name: Mint Black Widow
monsters.lore: A Black Widow with mint-green markings. Just as dangerous, but prettier.

monsters.name: Black Lizard
monsters.lore: Basks on the hot desert rocks by day and hunts in the shade at dusk.

monsters.name: Violet Black Lizard
monsters.lore: A Black Lizard with violet scales, rarely seen above ground.

monsters.name: Floating Stone
monsters.lore: A rock that forgot how to fall. Crystal Mountain is full of them, and they throw pebbles at climbers.

monsters.name: Amber Floating Stone
monsters.lore: A Floating Stone of warm amber. Something tiny seems to be trapped inside.

monsters.name: Golden Cloud
monsters.lore: A cloud of gold dust that spins and flashes. Miners follow them hoping to find treasure.

monsters.name: Azure Golden Cloud
monsters.lore: A Golden Cloud with a blue tint, said to rain silver coins once a year.

monsters.name: Gem Crawler
monsters.lore: A beetle encrusted with crystals that shine when it moves. Its flash lights up whole caverns.

monsters.name: Crimson Gem Crawler
monsters.lore: A Gem Crawler covered in ruby-red crystals. Jewellers dream of finding one.

monsters.name: Fire Bear
monsters.lore: A bear with fur like embers that roams the snowy forest, melting a path wherever it walks.

monsters.name: Starry Fire Bear
monsters.lore: A Fire Bear whose fur sparkles with tiny stars. It glows warmly in the snow.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.lore: A winged horse that soars above Snow White Forest. It rarely lands, and only for the worthy.

monsters.name: Rosy Pegasus
monsters.lore: A Pegasus with rose-pink wings. Seeing one is considered a blessing.

monsters.name: Phantom
monsters.lore: A cold spirit that floats through snowy woods and sleepy streets, whispering in your ear.

monsters.name: Frosted Phantom
monsters.lore: A Phantom frozen into icy blue, haunting the shores of Briarmere.

monsters.name: Snowman
monsters.lore: Someone built it, and then it walked away. Its frost breath chills to the bone.

monsters.name: Shadow Snowman
monsters.lore: A Snowman made of grey, dirty snow. It's not friendly about it.

monsters.name: Poison Skeleton
monsters.lore: Old bones held together by a nasty magic. It throws webs and bites with a poisonous grin.

monsters.name: Sunny Poison Skeleton
monsters.lore: A Poison Skeleton with sun-bleached golden bones. Strangely cheerful for a skeleton.

monsters.name: Shadow Ape
monsters.lore: A huge dark ape that guards the paths near Moonwhisper. It throws boulders like pebbles.

monsters.name: Mint Shadow Ape
monsters.lore: A Shadow Ape with mint-green fur. Even bigger, if that's possible.

monsters.name: Red Butterfly
monsters.lore: A butterfly with fiery wings. Where it flutters, little embers fall.

monsters.name: Night Monkey
monsters.lore: A Wood Monkey's cousin that only comes out after dark, with a bite full of shadow.

monsters.name: Mud Slime
monsters.lore: A Jelly Puff that rolled in the mud and never washed. Squelchy and surprisingly heavy.

monsters.name: Fire Crab
monsters.lore: A crab with a red-hot shell. Fishermen use it to cook their lunch, carefully.

monsters.name: Black Bull
monsters.lore: A Blaze Bull's darker cousin. Its eyes glow in the night, and its charge is just as hard.

monsters.name: Light Mouse
monsters.lore: A tiny mouse that glows softly. It lights the way for lost travellers in Shiverdell.

monsters.name: Earth Snake
monsters.lore: Burrows through the cavern floor and pops up to spit mud at your boots.

monsters.name: Light Snake
monsters.lore: A snake whose scales shine like polished glass in the desert sun.

monsters.name: Light Hedgehog
monsters.lore: A Hedgehog whose spines glow like little candles in the desert night.

monsters.name: Mining Lizard
monsters.lore: A lizard that digs for ore in the mountains and throws rocks at anyone near its find.

monsters.name: Frost Bear
monsters.lore: A Fire Bear's icy cousin, white as fresh snow, with a breath that freezes the air.

monsters.name: Rat King
monsters.lore: The boss of Rat Cavern: a fat, crowned rat that rules its tunnels with fire and fury.

monsters.name: Drunk Dragon
monsters.lore: A dragon who drank too much at the desert oasis. Wobbly, loud, and still very much a dragon.

monsters.name: Big Bad Wolf
monsters.lore: The wolf of the old stories. It prowls Snow White Forest looking for anyone in a red hood.

monsters.name: Golden Slime
monsters.lore: A slime made of molten gold. Adventurers hunt it for riches; it doesn't appreciate that.

monsters.name: Candy Puff
monsters.lore: A Jelly Puff made of sugar. It tastes as sweet as it looks, but don't try.

monsters.name: Temple Jelly
monsters.lore: Sacred jellies that guard the Tidewater Shrine, blessed by its ancient springs.

monsters.name: Earth Wolf
monsters.lore: A sandy-brown wolf that hunts in packs on the mountain trails.

monsters.name: Flame Wolf
monsters.lore: A wolf with a burning mane, part of the pack in Big Bad Wolf's Lair.

monsters.name: Wooden Puppet
monsters.lore: A carved puppet brought to life by a strange magic on Marionette Rise. It still dances when nobody's looking.

monsters.name: Lotus Sprite
monsters.lore: A tiny spirit born from a lotus flower. It blesses the ponds of Lotus Land.

monsters.name: Dream Phantom
monsters.lore: A phantom that lives in the dreams of Dozywick's residents, and won't let them wake.

monsters.name: Dreamstone Golem
monsters.lore: A golem made of dreamstone, built to guard the riches of Ingothold. It never stops working.

monsters.name: Crystal Widow
monsters.lore: A spider made of living crystal, spinning glittering webs in the Whispering Hollow.

monsters.name: Emerald Pegasus
monsters.lore: A green-winged Pegasus that guards the Emerald Road, shining like a jewel.

monsters.name: Gilded Brute
monsters.lore: A servant of the Gilded King, guarding the depths of Gooey Grotto with fire and roars.

monsters.name: Howlmaster
monsters.lore: The leader of the wolf pack, scarred and wise. Every wolf in the lair answers to it.

monsters.name: Marionette King
monsters.lore: The master of Marionette Rise, who pulls the strings of every puppet there.

monsters.name: Craghulk
monsters.lore: A mountain of rock that snores in the cave by Dozywick. Its snoring has kept the whole town dreaming for a year.

monsters.name: Morvane
monsters.lore: A dark lord of legend who waits on the Hidden Steppe. Few who face it come back to tell the tale.

monsters.name: Wavecrest Dragon
monsters.lore: The ancient guardian of the Tidewater Shrine, with scales like ocean waves.

monsters.name: Silverfang Warden
monsters.lore: A lieutenant of the Silver Wraith, guarding the Whispering Hollow with cold steel.

monsters.name: Emerald Dragon
monsters.lore: The legendary dragon at the end of the Emerald Road, the greatest challenge in Storyleaf.

monsters.name: Grumpy Old Oak
monsters.lore: An old oak tree that's been grumpy for a thousand years. It hates having its branches climbed.

monsters.name: Great Wisp
monsters.lore: The mother of all Wisps, a huge glowing light at the heart of Shiverdell.

monsters.name: Moon Rabbit Queen
monsters.lore: The queen of the moon rabbits, who descends on Moonwhisper when the moon is full.

monsters.name: Starmoth
monsters.lore: Moths drawn to the fallen star's light. Their wings carry its dust, and they drink the glow from any lantern left out at night.

monsters.name: Dawn Starmoth
monsters.lore: A Starmoth that flew too close to the sunrise. Its wings have blushed pink ever since.

monsters.name: Nebula Puff
monsters.lore: A puff of the night sky that drifted down with the fallen star. It settles on moonflowers and lulls them to sleep.

monsters.name: Crystal Quill
monsters.lore: A hedgehog whose quills turned to crystal where the starlight landed. It digs up crystal gardens for a crunchy snack.

monsters.name: Fallen Star
monsters.lore: The star that fell on Starfall Isle long ago. Awake on its hill, lonely and far from home, it blazes at anyone who comes near.
